_comment: Attunement rules per temperament. Resonance is 0-100; a creature joins the party at capture_threshold. Each species picks one temperament and an attunement_rate (data/creatures.json) that scales its *gains* only -- mistakes cost the same regardless of rate. stall_flee_turns is universal: any turn Resonance does not increase counts toward it, and it resets on a gain. See docs/DESIGN.md section 13.

gain: It stops pulling away quite so hard.
Something in it settles, just a little.
It lets you hold its gaze a moment longer.
reset: It flinches back to where it started.
Whatever ground you had is gone.
It remembers, suddenly, that you are dangerous.
stalled: It watches you, unconvinced either way.
Nothing changes. It is waiting to see what you do.

gain: It takes the blow without complaint. That was earned.
Something like respect crosses its face.
It squares back up to you, unbothered.
penalty_still: It reads your hesitation as weakness.
Standing down insults it more than a blow would.
It will not be courted. It wants a fight.
penalty_disrespect: That was not a fair strike, and it knows it.
It bristles at being outmatched so easily.
stalled: It is too hurt now for a blow to mean anything.
It holds its ground, waiting for something worth answering.

gain: It stops fighting the exhaustion and just breathes.
Too tired to run, it stays where it is.
healed: It shakes off the damage like it was nothing.
The moment is gone -- it is dangerous again.
stalled: It is still strong enough to fight this off.
It has not tired enough to stop resisting.
